title: Our Story

image.alt: Sunlit wheat stalks in a golden field

introduction: Big Data in a Box (BDiB) was founded on a simple insight: small and medium-sized organic farmers spend too much valuable time on paperwork. The inspiration occurred when Dr. Sree Nilakanta listened to an NPR broadcast highlighting the frustrations of organic growers undergoing seed-to-sale certification audits.
quote: "Achieving compliance and record-keeping shouldn't keep you from focusing on your crops. We wanted to build tools that return desk hours back to field hours."
history: Leveraging programs at the Iowa State University (ISU) Pappajohn Entrepreneurship Center, the founding team pivoted from hardware storage modules into building SPIDER Ag—an intelligent, cloud-backed voice and OCR tracking system built in Ames, Iowa.
